# Generated from source. For a per-page index see /llms.txt

# Introduction
URL: /docs/introduction
Summary: What Aider is, who it is for, and the problem it solves.

## The problem

AI agents increasingly need to spend money: API calls, credits, sub-agent fees, dataset downloads.
The naive solution is to give the agent a wallet with funds — but that hands the agent full control.
You need something in between: autonomous spending on small things, owner control over anything larger,
and the ability to cut off access immediately if something goes wrong.

## What Aider does

Aider is a smart contract on Arc. The owner deposits USDC and grants agents access with explicit limits:

- perPaymentLimit: the most an agent can spend in a single transaction
- dailyLimit: the most an agent can spend per UTC day
- expiresAt: the key stops working after this Unix timestamp (0 = never)
- Recipient rules: allow any recipient, or restrict to an approved allowlist

Within-limit payments execute immediately. Over-limit payments create an approval request;
funds are reserved until the owner approves or rejects it. Revoke an agent in one transaction.

## Who is it for

Owners: developers or teams running AI agents who want to give agents budget without full wallet access.
Agents: AI coding agents (Claude Code, custom scripts) that need to make payments as part of their work.

## What it is not

Not a custodial service — funds live in the contract, only you can withdraw.
Not production-ready — unaudited experiment, do not use for large amounts.

---

# Quickstart for owners
URL: /docs/quickstart-owners
Summary: Create a wallet, deposit USDC, and add an agent with limits.

Contract address (Arc Testnet): 0xed32e15d81e7864bf19caea4333bd0781f328ba3

## 1. Create a wallet

Call createWallet() — records msg.sender as owner, returns a wallet ID.

## 2. Deposit USDC

First approve the contract:
  cast send 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000 "approve(address,uint256)" \
    0xed32e15d81e7864bf19caea4333bd0781f328ba3 100000000 \
    --rpc-url https://rpc.testnet.arc.io --private-key $OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY

Then deposit:
  cast send 0xed32e15d81e7864bf19caea4333bd0781f328ba3 \
    "deposit(uint256,uint256)" 1 100000000 \
    --rpc-url https://rpc.testnet.arc.io --private-key $OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY

100 USDC = 100000000 (6 decimals).

## 3. Add an agent

  cast send 0xed32e15d81e7864bf19caea4333bd0781f328ba3 \
    "addAgent(uint256,address,string,uint256,uint256,uint256)" \
    1 0xAGENT_ADDRESS "Claude Code" 100000 500000 0 \
    --rpc-url https://rpc.testnet.arc.io --private-key $OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY

Parameters: walletId, agentAddress, label, perPaymentLimit (6-dec), dailyLimit (6-dec), expiresAt (0=never).

---

# Quickstart for agents
URL: /docs/quickstart-agents
Summary: Install aidr, configure it, and make your first payment.

## Install

  git clone https://github.com/bigjoe-io/aider
  cd aider/cli && bun install && bun run build

## aidr init

  node dist/index.js init --wallet 1 --key 0xYOUR_PRIVATE_KEY

Saves config to ~/.leash/config.json and key to ~/.leash/key, both mode 600.

## aidr balance

  node dist/index.js balance

JSON response includes wallet.available, agent.remainingToday, agent.perPaymentLimit, agent.active.

## First payment

  node dist/index.js pay 0xRECIPIENT 0.05 "API credits for run #1"

On success: {"status":"paid","txHash":"0x...","amount":"$0.05","memo":"..."}
Over limit: {"status":"pending_approval","requestId":"3","expiresAt":"..."}
Error:      {"status":"error","error":"OverPerPaymentLimit","message":"...","hint":"..."}

---

# How it works
URL: /docs/how-it-works
Summary: The contract, where funds live, and the life of a payment.

## Actors

Owner: called createWallet(). Deposits funds, sets limits, approves/rejects requests, withdraws.
Agent: added with addAgent(). Signs agentPay/requestPayment. Cannot withdraw, change limits, or approve.

## The contract

Single non-upgradeable contract on Arc Testnet: 0xed32e15d81e7864bf19caea4333bd0781f328ba3
Uses ERC-20 USDC at 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000 (6 decimals).
No global admin — each wallet is independently owned.

## Where funds live

balance: total USDC in the wallet (including reserved)
reserved: locked by pending approval requests
available: balance − reserved (what agents can spend, owners can withdraw)

## Life of a payment

Instant: agentPay checks wallet/agent/recipient/limit/balance, then transfers USDC directly.
Request: requestPayment reserves funds, creates PENDING record, owner approves/rejects.
Blocked: wallet paused, agent revoked/expired, or recipient blocked → revert with custom error.

## Daily limit window

Resets at UTC midnight. Contract uses: block.timestamp − (block.timestamp % 86400).
First payment each day auto-resets spentToday to 0.

---

# Agent payments
URL: /docs/agent-payments
Summary: What agentPay checks, in order, and what each failure means.

agentPay(walletId, to, amount, memo) checks in order:

1. Wallet exists (owner ≠ 0x0)                     → WALLET_NOT_FOUND
2. Caller is a known agent                           → AgentNotActive
3. agent.active == true                              → AgentRevokedError
4. agent.expiresAt == 0 || block.timestamp ≤ expiresAt → AgentExpired
5. wallet.paused == false                            → WalletPaused
6. to ≠ 0x0                                          → ZeroAddress
7. amount > 0                                        → ZeroAmount
8. !blocklist[walletId][to]                          → RecipientBlocked
9. if ALLOWLIST mode: allowlist[walletId][to]        → RecipientNotAllowed
10. amount ≤ agent.perPaymentLimit                   → OverPerPaymentLimit
11. (daily reset) spentToday + amount ≤ dailyLimit   → OverDailyLimit
12. balance − reserved ≥ amount                      → InsufficientBalance

On success: spentToday += amount, balance -= amount, IERC20.transfer(to, amount), emit AgentPaid.

---

# Approval requests
URL: /docs/approval-requests
Summary: Over-limit payments, fund reservation, approve/reject/expire.

Created by: requestPayment(walletId, to, amount, memo, ttlSeconds)
CLI hardcodes TTL = 1800 seconds (30 minutes).

States: PENDING → APPROVED | REJECTED | EXPIRED

Fund reservation: wallet.reserved += amount on creation, -= amount on resolution.
No agent can cause a reservation to disappear — only owner approve/reject, or post-TTL expireRequest().

approveRequest: owner only, re-validates recipient against current policy, transfers USDC.
rejectRequest: owner only, releases reservation, no funds moved.
expireRequest: anyone, only after TTL, releases reservation.

Approved requests do NOT count toward agent's daily limit (spentToday is unchanged).

---

# Spending rules
URL: /docs/spending-rules
Summary: Every rule — type, default, example, and how to change it.

Agent rules (set via addAgent, changed via updateAgent):
  perPaymentLimit: uint256, USDC 6-dec, example 100000 ($0.10)
  dailyLimit:      uint256, USDC 6-dec, example 500000 ($0.50)
  expiresAt:       uint256, Unix timestamp, 0 = never
  label:           string, owner reference only

Wallet rules:
  paused:          bool, default false — blocks all agent payments when true
  recipientMode:   ANY (0) or ALLOWLIST (1), default ANY
  allowlist:       mapping address→bool, empty by default
  blocklist:       mapping address→bool, empty by default, overrides allowlist and mode

Change functions (owner only):
  updateAgent(walletId, agent, perPaymentLimit, dailyLimit, expiresAt)
  pauseWallet(walletId, bool)
  setRecipientMode(walletId, uint8)
  setAllowlist(walletId, address, bool)
  setBlocklist(walletId, address, bool)

All changes take effect immediately.

---

# Revoking and pausing
URL: /docs/revoke-and-pause
Summary: Revoke one agent or stop every agent at once.

revokeAgent(walletId, agentAddress): sets active=false. Instant, permanent until re-added.
  After: agentPay and requestPayment revert with AgentRevokedError.
  Pending requests: NOT auto-rejected. Owner must handle them manually.

pauseWallet(walletId, true): blocks ALL agents. Owner's own actions unaffected.
pauseWallet(walletId, false): resumes.

Revoke vs pause:
  revokeAgent    → one agent, reversible with addAgent
  pauseWallet    → every agent, reversible with pauseWallet(false)

---

# Agent-to-agent payments
URL: /docs/agent-to-agent
Summary: One agent paying another agent's wallet directly.

Pass the receiving agent's Ethereum address as `to` in agentPay.
The contract does not distinguish agents from humans — it is just an address.
USDC lands in the receiving agent's EOA. No automatic deposit into their Aider wallet.
Allowlist/blocklist checks still apply.

Example:
  node dist/index.js pay 0xAGENT_B_ADDRESS 0.08 "Summarisation job for task #42"

---

# Watching activity
URL: /docs/watching-activity
Summary: Contract events, what each contains, and how to listen.

Events:
  WalletCreated(walletId*, owner*)
  Deposited(walletId*, amount)
  Withdrawn(walletId*, amount)
  WalletPausedEvent(walletId*, paused)
  AgentAdded(walletId*, agent*, label)
  AgentUpdated(walletId*, agent*)
  AgentRevoked(walletId*, agent*)
  AgentPaid(walletId*, agent*, to*, amount, memo)
  PaymentRequested(requestId*, walletId*, agent*, to, amount, memo, expiresAt)
  RequestApproved(requestId*, walletId*)
  RequestRejected(requestId*, walletId*)
  RequestExpired(requestId*, walletId*)
  RecipientModeSet(walletId*, mode)
  AllowlistUpdated(walletId*, recipient, allowed)
  BlocklistUpdated(walletId*, recipient, blocked)

(* = indexed)

aidr history scans last 10,000 blocks for AgentPaid events filtered by walletId + agent.

viem example:
  client.watchEvent({ address: CONTRACT, event: parseAbiItem('event AgentPaid(...)'), args: { walletId: 1n }, onLogs: ... })

---

# Security model
URL: /docs/security-model
Summary: What a leaked key can and cannot do, and what the owner must protect.

WARNING: Aider is unaudited and experimental.

A compromised agent key CAN:
  - agentPay up to perPaymentLimit per tx
  - spend up to dailyLimit per UTC day
  - create requestPayment for larger amounts (visible to owner)

A compromised agent key CANNOT:
  - withdraw (owner-only)
  - change its own limits (owner-only)
  - approve its own requests (owner-only)
  - add agents (owner-only)
  - spend after revokeAgent

Key storage: ~/.leash/config.json and ~/.leash/key, both mode 600.
Key is never printed, logged, or included in JSON output.

Owner must protect: owner private key (controls all wallets), monitor pending requests,
revoke unused agents, withdraw idle funds.

Contract protections: ReentrancyGuard, CEI ordering, custom errors, 52 unit tests.
Not independently audited.

---

# Errors
URL: /docs/errors
Summary: Every contract error, the CLI message, and what to do.

WalletPaused        0x3c1bfd9e  wallet is paused           call pauseWallet(id, false)
AgentNotActive      0x29c9d28e  never added or removed     re-add with addAgent
AgentRevokedError   0x3d4fa12a  agent was revoked          re-add with addAgent
AgentExpired        0x8af8ae35  key past expiresAt         updateAgent with later expiresAt
RecipientNotAllowed 0x6c7bcc15  not on allowlist           setAllowlist or switch to ANY mode
RecipientBlocked    0x55b6cf7f  on blocklist               setBlocklist(addr, false)
OverPerPaymentLimit 0x53c98e2e  over per-tx cap            CLI auto-requests; or raise limit
OverDailyLimit      0x1f2a2005  over daily cap             CLI auto-requests; or wait for reset
InsufficientBalance 0xf4d678b8  not enough available USDC  deposit more or reduce request
RequestNotPending   —           request not in PENDING     check status with aidr status
RequestExpiredError —           TTL passed, owner cannot approve
RequestNotExpiredYet —          TTL not yet passed, cannot expire
ZeroAmount          —           amount = 0                 validated by CLI before tx
ZeroAddress         —           address = 0x0              validated by CLI before tx
InvalidTTL          —           ttlSeconds = 0             CLI hardcodes 1800, never 0
NotWalletOwner      —           caller not owner           only owner can call this function

---

# Best practices
URL: /docs/best-practices
Summary: Limits, memos, history checks, unused agents, and idle funds.

1. Start with small limits. Raise them later. Think: worst-case daily spend if key is stolen.
2. One key per agent. Never share. Separate keys = separate revocation + auditable history.
3. Write clear memos. Good: "API credits — run #42, model gpt-4o". Bad: "payment".
4. Check aidr history before retrying. A timed-out request may have succeeded onchain.
5. Revoke unused agents. A dormant key with limits is an unnecessary attack surface.
6. Withdraw idle funds. Do not leave large balances in the contract long-term.

---

# CLI reference
URL: /docs/cli-reference
Summary: Every aidr command — usage, flags, and JSON output.

Binary: node dist/index.js (built from cli/)
JSON to stdout, human-readable to stderr/stdout. Exit 0 = success, 1 = error.

## init
  node dist/index.js init --wallet <id> --key <hex> [--contract <addr>] [--mainnet]
  Flags: --wallet (req), --key (req), --contract (opt, default testnet addr), --mainnet (opt)
  Output: {"status":"configured","walletId","agentAddress","contractAddress","network","configSaved","keySaved"}

## balance
  node dist/index.js balance
  Output: {"wallet":{id,balance,reserved,available,paused},"agent":{address,label,active,perPaymentLimit,dailyLimit,spentToday,remainingToday,expiresAt}}

## pay
  node dist/index.js pay <to> <amount> <memo> [--no-request]
  Args: to (Eth addr), amount (decimal USDC), memo (non-empty string)
  Flags: --no-request (disable requestPayment fallback)
  Success:  {"status":"paid","txHash","explorer","to","amount","memo","gasUsed"}
  Pending:  {"status":"pending_approval","requestId","txHash","explorer","to","amount","memo","expiresAt"}
  Error:    {"status":"error","error","message","hint"}
  Auto-fallback on: OverPerPaymentLimit, OverDailyLimit, InsufficientBalance
  No fallback on:   WalletPaused, AgentRevoked, AgentExpired, RecipientBlocked, RecipientNotAllowed

## status
  node dist/index.js status <requestId>
  Output: {"requestId","status","walletId","agent","to","amount","memo","expiresAt","expired"}
  status: PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED | EXPIRED

## wait
  node dist/index.js wait <requestId>
  Polls every 5 seconds until status leaves PENDING.
  Exit 0 on APPROVED, exit 1 on REJECTED or EXPIRED.
  No built-in timeout — use: timeout 600 node dist/index.js wait <id>

## history
  node dist/index.js history
  Scans last 10,000 blocks for AgentPaid events (this agent + wallet).
  Output: {"status":"ok","count","total","payments":[{txHash,explorer,blockNumber,walletId,agent,to,toExplorer,amount,memo},...]}
  Sorted newest-first.

# Contract reference
URL: /docs/contract-reference
Summary: Every function, view, event, and error in the Aider contract.

Contract: 0xed32e15d81e7864bf19caea4333bd0781f328ba3 (Arc Testnet)
USDC: 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000
Solidity 0.8.28, Cancun EVM, non-upgradeable, no admin.

State-mutating (owner-only unless noted):
  createWallet() → walletId                               anyone
  deposit(walletId, amount)                               owner
  withdraw(walletId, amount)                              owner
  pauseWallet(walletId, bool)                             owner
  addAgent(walletId, agent, label, perPayment, daily, exp) owner
  updateAgent(walletId, agent, perPayment, daily, exp)    owner
  revokeAgent(walletId, agent)                            owner
  setRecipientMode(walletId, mode)                        owner
  setAllowlist(walletId, recipient, bool)                 owner
  setBlocklist(walletId, recipient, bool)                 owner
  agentPay(walletId, to, amount, memo)                    agent
  requestPayment(walletId, to, amount, memo, ttl) → requestId  agent
  approveRequest(requestId)                               owner
  rejectRequest(requestId)                                owner
  expireRequest(requestId)                                anyone (after TTL)

View functions:
  getWallet(walletId) → (owner, balance, reserved, available, paused, mode)
  getAgent(walletId, agent) → (label, perPaymentLimit, dailyLimit, expiresAt, active, spentToday, dayStart)
  getRequest(requestId) → PaymentRequest struct
  getPendingRequests(walletId) → uint256[] (O(n) over all requests)
  isAllowlisted(walletId, recipient) → bool
  isBlocklisted(walletId, recipient) → bool
  isRecipientPermitted(walletId, recipient) → bool
  nextWalletId() → uint256
  nextRequestId() → uint256
  USDC_TOKEN() → address

# Glossary
URL: /docs/glossary
Summary: Owner, agent, wallet, limit, approval request, reservation, and more.

Owner: address that called createWallet(). Controls funds, limits, approvals, withdrawals.
Agent: address added with addAgent(). Signs payments. Cannot withdraw, change limits, or approve.
Agent key: Ethereum private key for the agent. Stored in ~/.leash/key mode 600. Never printed.
Wallet: contract record (numeric ID) holding a USDC balance and a set of agents. Not an EOA.
perPaymentLimit: max USDC per single agentPay call. Exceeding → requestPayment.
dailyLimit: max USDC per UTC day via agentPay. Resets at UTC midnight.
Approval request: created by requestPayment when over limit. Funds reserved until resolved.
Reservation: USDC locked by pending requests. available = balance − reserved.
TTL: seconds before a request can be expired. CLI hardcodes 1800 (30 min). Must be > 0.
Revoke: revokeAgent() sets active=false. Agent blocked immediately. Reversible with addAgent.
Pause: pauseWallet(true) blocks all agents on the wallet. Reversible with pauseWallet(false).
Allowlist: in ALLOWLIST mode, only these addresses can receive agent payments.
Blocklist: these addresses can never receive agent payments, regardless of mode.
USDC: USD Coin, 6 decimals, 1 USDC = 1_000_000. ERC-20 at 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000.
Arc: blockchain where USDC is the native gas token.
spentToday: per-agent daily spend counter. Auto-reset on first payment of each new UTC day.
dayStart: UTC midnight timestamp when spentToday was last reset.
